unit: MD monetary values in billions; IC for native construction costs; resource units are native production/research requirements.
starting_production: Zero raw uranium production in every state; 57 surveyed districts enable paid mine development.

mine.upkeep_adjustment: Infrastructure cost modifier, common_money_modifier (GDP/c and inflation) and native population-size scaling.
mine.working_output: 3–12 raw units/level by deposit; damaged levels produce no additional uranium.

enrichment.shortage_output: Proportional, with zero new fuel output when uranium supply is zero.
enrichment.cash_note: No additional standalone enrichment-facility operating fee was introduced; existing native reactor upkeep remains in infrastructure spending.

weapons_research_budgets.active_condition: Actual special project being researched; both add if active together; no arsenal-size exemption.
weapons_research_budgets.lifecycle: Calculated on native economic refresh; completion/cancellation resets the rate, disruption does not waive costs.
display: Atomic bomb and warhead project descriptions
weapons_research_budgets.refresh_safety: Rate calculation overwrites its result and never directly modifies treasury.

raid_policy: 50/50 raids block AI in both available and launchable.
